record.name: Bahrain
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Bahrain has a national AI policy and a UNESCO readiness assessment, and nothing more was found.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Some submitted strings contain site. rather than site:; these literal strings are preserved and are not treated as domain-restricted searches. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. Preserved result batches, using 1-based positions in check.searches: BH-search = searches 1, 2 (en, ar). Each multi-query batch has only a combined returned result set; its source_ids cannot be attributed to individual queries. Historical query dates are recorded as 17 October 2026 in the phase6 search-boundary ledger.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The iGA's account identifies the ministerial ICT committee, its AI framework work and readiness assessment, giving substantive national governance context.

related_bodies.role: It leads digital government and AI readiness work.

record.notes: The National Cyber Security Center runs a responsible-AI awareness campaign. The campaign addresses safe and responsible use across public and private entities. Searches covered indexed public English and Arabic sources for a government-designated AI safety institute with a remit to evaluate advanced models.
